name: scratchpad
description: A session-scoped workspace for interactive HTML artifacts and visually verified UI variants.

interface.shortDescription: Interactive HTML artifacts with visual verification
interface.longDescription: Scratchpad gives the agent a session workspace, a sandboxed interactive HTML artifact surface for plans, specifications, dashboards, design systems, and micro-apps, plus a separate pixel-inspection channel for visually verifying the same work. It stays quiet on ordinary tasks.
defaultPrompt: Turn this plan into an interactive HTML artifact.
Open three UI variants and visually compare them.
Build a disposable decision workbench for this choice.
